digest.component_or_area: Jira dispatch retry and outcome management
propositions: A single provider-neutral retry budget unifies Cloud ACLI/REST and DC SDK writes to prevent timeout-induced duplicate writes or ambiguous acceptance

One logical operation carries a stable contract with desired postcondition, invocation/request counts, disposition, failure scope, and bounded diagnostic entries (max 8, each capped at 512 Unicode code points)
Retry schedule is 2^(attempt+1) + U[0,1) with at most three invocations and 15 seconds cumulative sleep, respecting provider Retry-After as a lower bound
Cloud summary-write executes one ACLI process per write with sanitized exit/stdout/stderr decoding; recovery uses primary-store REST GET with no sleep
DC summary-write is exactly GET → PUT → GET with no hidden repeats; dedicated executor passes max_retries=0 and fails fast if _session.max_retries != 0

Desired summary observed after timeout or conclusive old state within remaining budget returns recovered success; failed, inconclusive, or over-budget observation returns non-replaying commit_unknown or retry_not_before
